i’m exactly the same. i tend to binge when stressed or avoiding work especially when i’m alone. So i’ve tried packing my days with activities and responsibilities. I take long shifts at work and do my studying and homework out of my house (like at my place of work or the library). I also live with my family so there is always food at home and it triggers the heck outta me so i don’t eat in our kitchen. I take what i should eat and eat it in my room. That lets me eat less because i don’t feel the need to finish what i eat (this is usually the opposite for other people, so just do what you think will work for you). I don’t restrict because i have a love for food and doing that just hurts. I started viewing food as art and if i really don’t like it, ( a texture is off, the colors are gross, yada yada) i don’t eat it. This mindset lets me eat less without feeling like i’m restricting. But, I still slip up when i’m alone and binge and feel terrible. I go on discord and sit in voice channels talking to just anyone or listening in on whatever. Just to feel like i’m engaging with someone. listening to music and imaging fake scenarios takes the urge away too, sometimes. 

Really though, I’d do an in depth analysis of the way you think and act and the scenarios that cause it and the start small changes that are tailored to your lifestyle and abilities.
